workspaceCommandQueue.behavior: one shared promise queue serializes the configured workspace command runtime

childProcessBoundary.behavior: each workspace process uses a real child_process with bounded output, process-group cleanup and an admission lease

decision: No queue relaxation in this slice: command effects share a workspace and the policy is mutation/reconcilable, so text-based read-only inference would be unsafe.
nextSafeDirection: Add an explicit read-only workspace operation with its own bounded concurrency and capability/authorization contract, then compare it against the serial mutation command path.
limitations: The timings are inherited from the isolated 2026-10-16 latency evidence, not a new packaged desktop run.
The child-process total includes spawn, scheduling, pipes and cleanup; it is not file I/O time alone.
